logp.method_description: Calibration curves (graphs of absorbances and concentrations, Fig.S14) of complexes 1 and 2 in buffer 7.4 and 1-octanol were carried out. The traditional shake flask method was used as an experimental technique. Complexes 1 and 2 (each for 1.0 mg) were dissolved into 125 mL conical flasks containing a 1:1 ratio of phosphate buffer pH 7.4: 1-octanol (25:25 mL). Complexes 1 and 2 was shaken (500 rpm) in 1-octanol-saturated phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) for 72 h to make sure that equilibrium concentration was reached. Two layers of complexes in buffer 7.4 and 1-octanol were separated by separatory funnel. Each partition was measured its absorbance at 305 nm and determined its concentration. lipophilicity index (logPow) was calculated from the equation (2). log Pow = log (Ao/Aw). where Ao and Aw are absorbances of complex in 1-octanol and phosphate buffer 7.4 partitions, respectively.
